attribution.title: Huis De Pinto
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free low-poly reconstruction of the exact mapped museum/cultural-house building, cross-checked against current PDOK BAG. Pinto’s twin historic roofs remain behind the monumental parapet; the Tulip Museum occupies the actual combined 1927 Prinsengracht116–118 apartment/shop block with straight brick cornice. Neighboring buildings and any open rear spaces are retained.
